dashboard.title: Practice home
dashboard.subtitle: Here you will see a summary of your working day.
dashboard.sessionsEmpty: There are no scheduled sessions yet.
dashboard.activityEmpty: When your patients complete activities, you will see them here.

adult.welcomeBody: This is your space. Here you will find your appointments and the activities your psychologist shares with you.
adult.activitiesEmpty: You have no pending activities for now.

child.welcomeBody: Your activities will show up here. Let's go step by step!
child.activitiesEmpty: There are no activities yet. Come back soon!

signIn.title: Welcome
signIn.description: Sign in to reach your workspace.
signIn.expiredIdle: We signed you out after a period of inactivity. Sign in again to continue.
signIn.expiredAbsolute: Your session reached its maximum length. Sign in again to continue.
signIn.mfaReset: We turned off your two-step verification. Sign in again and set up a new authenticator app.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for that email, we sent a link. Check your inbox; the link expires in one hour.
forgotPassword.linkInvalid: The link is not valid or has expired. Request a new one.

confirmLink.title: Confirm you want to change your password
confirmLink.description: To protect your account, the link is only used when you confirm. Press the button to continue; if you did not request this change, you can close this page.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: When you save it, we will sign out your other open sessions.
resetPassword.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A memorable phrase works well.
resetPassword.linkInvalidBody: It may have expired or already been used.

mfa.challengeDescription: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
mfa.useRecoveryCode: Don't have your app? Use a recovery code
mfa.enrollDescription: To protect clinical information, your account needs an authenticator app (for example, a code app on your phone).
mfa.enrollStep1: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to add the account to your authenticator app
mfa.manualKeyLabel: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app:
mfa.enrollStep2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
mfa.recoveryDescription: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each code works only once.
mfa.recoveryWarning: Using it turns off your current authenticator app, signs out all your sessions and asks you to set up a new one.
mfa.codesDescription: If you lose your phone, these codes let you get back in. Keep them somewhere safe.
mfa.codesNone: You don't have recovery codes yet.
mfa.codesRegenerate: Generate new codes (the previous ones stop working)
mfa.codesShownOnce: We will show them only this once. Copy or print them now.
mfa.codesReverify: For your security, verify your code again to generate new codes.

invitation.title: Accept your invitation
invitation.invalidTitle: We could not use this invitation
invitation.invalidBody: The link is not valid, was already used or has expired. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invitation.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. If you already have an account with this email, enter your current password.

settings.title: Settings
settings.inviteDescription: We will email them a link. It expires in {hours} hours and works only once.
settings.listEmpty: You haven't sent any invitations yet.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the practice owner can invite new members.

accessDenied.title: You don't have access to this section
accessDenied.body: Your account has no active team role in this practice. If you think this is a mistake, contact the practice owner.
accessDenied.selectOrganization: Your account belongs to several practices. Open the web address of the practice you want to use.

validation.passwordTooShort: The password must have at least 12 characters.
validation.passwordTooLong: The password is too long (72 bytes maximum).

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not correct.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.invalidCode: The code is not correct or has expired. Try again.
errors.invalidRecoveryCode: The recovery code is not valid or was already used.
errors.mfaAlreadyEnrolled: You already have an authenticator app. Verify your code to continue.
errors.enrollmentExpired: The setup expired. Generate a new QR code.
errors.invitationInvalid: We could not accept the invitation. Check the link and your password.
errors.weakPassword: That password is not strong enough. Choose another one.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.resetLinkExpired: Your link has expired. Request a new one.

emails.invitationSubject: You were invited to join a practice on Psi
emails.invitationBody:
Hello,

You were invited to join a practice team. To accept, open this link:

{link}

The link expires in {hours} hours and works only once. If you were not expecting this invitation, ignore this email.
emails.mfaResetSubject: Your two-step verification was turned off
emails.mfaResetBody:
Hello,

A recovery code was used on your account and we turned off your authenticator app. All your sessions were signed out.

If this was not you, contact your practice owner or support right away.

home.title: Choose a space
home.description: Provisional development view to move between the areas of the application.

states.emptyDescription: When there is information, it will show up here.
states.errorDescription: We could not show this page. Your data is safe. Please try again in a few seconds.

errors.notFoundDescription: The link may have changed or the page may no longer exist.

errors.mfaRequired: Verify your two-step code to continue.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.notFound: We could not find what you are looking for.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this information. Reload and try again.
errors.immutableRecord: This record can no longer be changed.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Try again in a few seconds.

errors.selectCapacity: Choose the practice you want to work with.
errors.organizationReadOnly: The practice is in read-only mode.
errors.recentMfaRequired: For your security, verify your two-step code again.
errors.emailUnavailable: Email delivery is not available. Try again later.

branding.title: Your practice branding
branding.cardDescription: The name, colors and logo your team and patients will see.
branding.description: Set how your practice looks: name, colors and logo. Changes apply to your whole team and your portal.
branding.ownerOnly: Only the practice owner can change the branding.
branding.loadError: We could not load your practice branding. Please try again later.

identity.title: Name and colors
identity.description: Colors adjust themselves when needed so text and buttons stay easy to read.

fields.displayNameHint: Up to {max} characters. Shown in the menu, on sign-in and in the portal.
fields.brandColorHint: Format #RRGGBB. Used for decoration; for text and buttons we calculate a readable shade.
fields.functionalColorPicker: Pick the color for text and buttons
fields.functionalColorHint: Only if you want to set it yourself. It needs a contrast of at least 4.5 to 1.
fields.secondaryColorHint: Used as a soft tint with dark text on top.

contrast.report: Color for text and buttons: {color} · contrast {ratio}:1
contrast.adjusted: We darkened your color slightly so it reads well.
contrast.rejected: This color does not have enough contrast: it reaches {ratio}:1 and needs at least {minimum}:1.
contrast.suggest: Try {color}, the closest shade that does.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Shown next to your practice name.
logo.none: You have not uploaded a logo yet.
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB and between 16 and 2048 pixels per side. SVG is not supported.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: This is how your branding looks in each space, before you save.
preview.sample: Sample text on the space's background.

validation.colorInvalid: Enter a color in the #RRGGBB format, for example #2f7d6d.
validation.versionRequired: Reload the page and try again.

errors.logoTooLarge: The logo is larger than 512 KB. Choose a lighter image.
errors.logoUnsupported: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP images are supported (not SVG).
errors.logoCorrupt: We could not read that image. Try another file.
errors.logoDimensions: The logo must be between 16 and 2048 pixels per side.
